name: economics-paper-reviewer
description: Evidence-grounded economics paper reviews using native ChatGPT Work subagents and deterministic PDF processing.

interface.longDescription: Attach an economics paper PDF and request a Full or Lite review. Native ChatGPT Work subagents audit the parsed paper, check evidence, and synthesize a traceable report, delivered as a PDF with its Markdown source preserved. Full retains all universal and applicable specialist audits; Lite keeps the same coverage with lower requested reasoning effort and is unbenchmarked. Uses the host's shared ChatGPT Work/Codex allowance, with no model API keys or API billing. Reviews can exhaust included usage. Requires a host with native subagents, Python PDF-processing dependencies, file access, and image viewing. Web verification depends on available search. Saves checkpoints for interrupted reviews; cannot guarantee quota, runtime capabilities, or completion.
